headline: CREA Report Highlights Economic Impact of Oil Inflation on US Households
summary: A report by CREA estimated global fuel inflation from Middle East conflict at $468 billion, with US consumers bearing $160 billion of the total costs.
why: Sustained retail gasoline and fuel inflation suppresses US consumer sentiment and discretionary household expenditures.

impacts.name: Consumer Discretionary
impacts.why: Steep transportation fuel expenditures divert discretionary spending away from general retail.
